mentions.name: Second iOS app (in development)
mentions.description: An iOS app currently in development, planned to be more complex than PeekCard and built for the author's own use. React Native was considered but rejected to avoid the overhead of testing on Android.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the current project I am building another iOS app, a bit more complex, also something I want to use myself. I was considering building with React Native, but ditched that plan because when I am building for myself, there would (I think) be a lot of overhead in testing Android.
